## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is based on develop and named feature/<task-id>-<short-name>
- [ ] The app starts and the affected feature works locally
- [ ] Tests pass for the area I changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or .env files are committed
- [ ] .env.example is updated if I added or renamed a variable
- [ ] Request and response shapes match the SDD API tables
- [ ] I read my own diff before requesting review
